======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SHAILENDRA SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 17-01-2023 Learned counsel Mr. Sanjeev Kumar, appearing for the appellant and learned APP Mr. B.M.P.
Sinha, appearing for the State are present and they are heard.
This appeal is admitted.
Call for LCR in Sessions Trial No. 335 of 2018 arsing out of Ramnagar P.S. Case No. 455 of 2017 from the Court of 3rd Additional Sessions Judge, Bagaha, West Champaran.

entities.text: Court of 3rd Additional Sessions Judge, Bagaha, West Champaran
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that the Trial Court convicted the appellant for the offences punishable under Section 498A of I.P.C. and under Section 4 of D.P. Act and the maximum punishment of imprisonment awarded upon the appellant is three years and after the conviction the appellant was granted provisional bail by the convicting Trial Court and he is still on bail and today is the last Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.245 of 2023(2) dt.17-01-2023 day of the provisional bail
and accordingly, a prayer has been made to confirm the said provisional bail.
Learned APP has no objection to the above-mentioned prayer.
Having considered the above submissions, the provisional bail granted to the appellant by the Trial Court is hereby confirmed on the same bail bond taken by the Trial Court.
